steward_note: Pacing=MERCER_IMMERSIVE; Pre-Roll DC=14; Science Vegetable=Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea; Active POV=enclave_05_kaio -> Handoff=enclave_13_ryn.
science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea
summary: Kaio scrambles up the slick, jagged basalt ridge as the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear whips the ferrofluid sea into a frenzy. She grabs the baton from Hector, securing the data packet before tossing it down to Ryn in the staging area.

horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Relay the critical magnetohydrodynamic data back to The Forge before the shear force compromises the data packet.
horizon_goals.mid_term_milestone: Stabilize the coastal energy relays ahead of the approaching storm front.
horizon_goals.campaign_arc_climax: Master the exoplanet's unpredictable magneto-weather phenomena.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The jagged coastline violently rips apart and reforms, the ferrofluid sea whipping into razor-sharp metallic peaks as the magnetic shear intensifies. Lightning dances off the heavy copper grounding shunts hammered into the bedrock, casting harsh, stroboscopic shadows across the slick stone. Above, the twin suns bleed through a thick, spore-laden gale that threatens to swallow the entire staging area.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Blinding white arcs of ozone discharge, the deep liquid obsidian of the sea, and the oxidized green of desperate copper repairs.
sensory_palette.sound: The deafening crack of thunderous discharge layered over the rhythmic, heavy slosh of metallic waves.
sensory_palette.smell: Scorched ozone, raw copper tang, and the musty rot of displaced fungal spores.
sensory_palette.tactile_temperature: A blistering wave of dielectric heat followed instantly by the icy bite of the storm wind.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: A sharp, metallic battery-acid tang on the back of the tongue.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be manually jammed deeper into the bedrock to secure the connection.
Can be cracked open to pull the ambient magnetic shear away from the sea.
Can be toppled to shield the forward sensors from the ferrofluid spray.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To rip apart any stable conductive structures along the coastline.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Generating cascading waves of intense polarity reversal that snap metal like dry twigs.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: The secondary data relay tower is vibrating at a fatal resonance frequency and is seconds from catastrophic failure.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: The tower will detonate, launching lethal copper shrapnel and severing the coastal relay.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: The magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear is vibrating the secondary data relay tower to the breaking point.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: If the tower fails, the coastal relays will overload and The Forge will lose critical power data.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: The colony's survival depends on mastering the exoplanet's aggressive magneto-weather phenomena.

judge_tactician.failure_stakes_declared: The data relay tower detonates, causing blunt trauma and forcing a chaotic retreat from the coast.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Kaio misjudges the resonance frequency, her strike worsening the vibration and triggering an immediate, violent explosion of the tower.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Kaio manages to secure the baton, but a burst of ferrofluid spray scores her armor and temporarily shorts out her comms.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Kaio perfectly times her catch between shear waves, locking the data packet safely and preparing for the handoff.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Kaio not only secures the baton but realizes the shear waves follow a predictable harmonic, information vital for future coastal engineering.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: Kaio catches the baton, her gloves smoking from the intense heat of the data transfer. She looks down at the staging area where Ryn is preparing the uplink. 'Data is secure! Catch, Ryn!'
